scope: 100% of 15 actionable signal instances after Bot and token-boundary corrections

review_input.blinding: not blinded; the evaluator saw the aggregate result and a superseded 19-case candidate set

criteria.true_directive: The reviewer requests a concrete change or missing validation, not merely mentioning a category.
criteria.material: The request plausibly prevents correctness, security, compatibility, reliability, data-loss or externally visible contract harm.
criteria.routine: Normal merge-readiness improvement such as useful tests or required documentation without explicit material impact.
criteria.low: Stylistic, optional, preference-only or administratively trivial request.
criteria.high: Explicit security, data integrity, outage, breaking contract or severe correctness risk.
criteria.medium: Concrete behavior, reliability, test protection or public contract risk that can justify delaying merge.
criteria.low_severity: Cosmetic, wording, minor style or optional enhancement.
criteria.acceptance_boundary: Blocking or resolved state is workflow evidence, not causal proof of acceptance.

evaluation.reviewer_type: model-assisted semantic review by the research agent
evaluation.limitation: Not independent or blinded; suitable only for filtering obvious proxy noise.

claim_boundary: Adjudication cannot produce mass-market GO, precision, decision-change, alert-acceptance, retention, willingness-to-pay or causal product-value claims.
